about: The RS-04 units in hand. Each record is filled from the motor tool's config export (python -m rig.rs04_inventory add <export.json>); fields stay null until the owner has scanned that unit. Never type a serial in by hand.

arrived.source: the owner, 2026-11-03: "we have 4 of the motors"

fields.uid: the 8-byte unique id the motor answers a scan with (hex): the unit's serial
fields.can_id: the CAN id it was given (1-4; 127 out of the box)
fields.joint: left-front, left-rear, right-front or right-rear (docs/body-firmware.md: ids 1-4)
fields.zero_offset_rad: add_offset (0x702B) after the zero was set, as exported
fields.zero_pose: the pose its zero was set at, as the tool names it
fields.mass_g: measured on a scale, in grams (catalog/leg_actuators.json carries the datasheet's 1510 g until then)
fields.profile: the build profile its stored settings came from, with its version
fields.exported: when the export the record came from was taken
fields.notes: anything else: damage, a fault seen, a swap
